summary: Iteration 42 - Availability Calendar & GSS Features COMPLETE. All 18 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working. Two new features fully functional: Real-time Availability Calendar and Guest Satisfaction Score (GSS) widget.

GSS composite score calculation properly weights: Reviews 50%, Sentiment 25%, Response 25%
Calendar handles month boundaries and leap years correctly
GSS label thresholds properly implemented (Exceptional ≥90, Excellent ≥80, Very Good ≥70, etc.)
Both endpoints properly require authentication (401 without token)
Room types show 0 rooms as expected (total_inventory=0 in seed data)
seed_data_creation: Using existing seeded data from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two new features added: (1) Availability Calendar at /api/availability/calendar/{property_id} showing room availability per day with color-coded occupancy, (2) GSS (Guest Satisfaction Score) at /api/gss/{property_id} showing composite KPI from reviews + messaging sentiment + response times. Both require authentication. GSS widget displays on Dashboard Home when gss > 0. Calendar accessible from sidebar under 'Booking Engine'.
